decisions.reason: Format reader/writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core data integration expertise. Their own dedicated page signals active commitment, and the firm can easily interpret customer feedback to refine them.

The building digital twin service extends established geospatial and data integration know-how into BIM/3D. The firm's own R&D and research participation give it the capacity to learn and improve, though the market is still emerging.

Authentication and identity delegation is close to the firm's integration and security components for GIS platforms. It may be consolidated with the identity service, but the underlying knowledge is retained and useful.
An open GIS application development framework fits the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and its long-standing developer expertise. This makes it a strategic base for future solutions.

The identity service was announced explicitly as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications. It builds on the firm's platform integration knowledge and supports its enterprise-integration direction.
